test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: There are 8 members P, Q, R, S, T, U, V and W are in a joint family. Q is brother of S. V is son of Q and R. S is brother of U. W is daughter of S and T. P is the wife of V. How is R related to P?
solution:
Family Chart :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b03043723fa44303c49903689ddd9c5494026994176632d193e0f3a301e73332.png] 

Family Tree:

1) Q is brother of S and S is brother of U.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cdaf144c97f31840042478b4c8ec46901f6807b00368a74a5deaa17d2b7dfbfc.png] 

2) V is son of Q and R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bbb6b4b313082277057ab3ce0061d8c869651c5f0e4aade901f9d554a214cdba.png] 

3) W is daughter of S and T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/45c1576f5b19359100cd47ecaae2e401fcad37ab17fa3b942d839c4c10256cac.png] 

4) P is the wife of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5de45be1ce8c7f775b35357fa68bb4b1be766b582e9698f4fce4be438bf194e.png] 

∴ Here, 'R' is mother-in-law of 'P'.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Mother-in-law".**
